question: Can a current-tree-valid no-new-cross option in the shared DP use observed residual paths to improve final routing, while bounded surrogate benefit, current prices and hysteresis limit harmful guide changes?
method: At actual VPR-selected net planning/refresh only, inspect prior chronological Qs static physical suffixes. Recompute each retained anchor current Tdel; require re_expand, sink layer, current native BB, simple real directed path, and no intersection with any current pruned-tree node after the anchor. No fresh query during this lookup. Validate all observed native graphs zeroRC. Invalid or unknown path gives no outside option. No global every-round replan.
proxy: For each legal observed suffix, raw outside units=(1+4*currentcriticality)*(current_anchor_Tdel+suffix_Tdel)/graphunit + opening_weight*sum bounded current negotiated premiums over unowned ordinary suffix nodes. Premium=(price-1)+/max(1,price), price recomputed with current acc_cost/pres_fac/occupancy/capacity and additional demand; never cached. This is a surrogate, not native congestion cost or latency optimum. Hold physical Tdel/STA/native congestion fixed.
controlled_benefit: OutsideCost=max(rawOutsideCost,(1-eta)*bestCurrentPhysicalLeafStandaloneCost). eta0 must leave the existing DP assignment/acceptance and entire native route exactly unchanged; choose physical on ties. eta.25 is initial bounded-benefit quality pilot, not a reliability probability. No blanket disable merely because a sink-layer source exists, and no assumption cache hit means near-optimal (134/1376 matched hits give worse UBs, max2.298914x).
DP: Add explicit optional outside-cost leaf field or equally explicit unique per-leaf option, with no newly opened crossing resource. Extend independent/shared solver, same-objective prior assignment reevaluation, group accounting and trace provenance to represent this kind without mapping a sentinel to a real RR node. Geometric/physical candidate sets and diversity retained. Tests must independently enumerate extended fixed-hierarchy optima and prior-assignment costs, including eta0 ties, invalid/missing witnesses and mixed leaf kinds.
guide_feedback: Choosing outside removes only that target soft crossing preference, never forces the witness or prunes native legal branches. Keep explicit outside metadata so intentional empty preference is distinct from missing guide. Revalidate anchor/path before missing-guide triggers for already native-selected reroutes; invalidation, actual criticality drift or existing congestion/path feedback may refresh. Preserve cooldown/hysteresis, non-target metadata and full transaction/best-state restores; no toggling just due intentional empty preference.
stages: 1 implement read-only current-pruned-tree legality/current-price lookup and log complete witness/context; default0 exact Qs, trace1 exact Qs, independent actualRRG/BB/tree-intersection/currentprice audit. 3 isolate physical-only vs current-price term and shared DP vs independent choices on same parameter/table where justified; freeze only after stable paired evidence, then expand beyond seen eltwise.
